honest_analysis: On clean MNIST data, Model B achieves 97.51% accuracy with 249 test errors. B's own softmax confidence achieves an impressive ROC-AUC of 0.9651, demonstrating strong self-calibration. B's 4-stat internal introspection achieves 0.6723 AUC, confirming that coarse activation stats carry substantial uncertainty information. The Observer Head reading B's full 256-dimensional hidden state achieves 0.8285 AUC. Comparing the representations: the full hidden state gives the external observer fine-grained access to feature geometry that coarse statistics collapse, while softmax confidence remains a formidable baseline on in-distribution data.
